gaps: P0: no candidates. P6: no photograph of the center or skyline (only suburbs Laubegast, Loschwitz, Gompitz and satellite images). No views of the 1945 ruins among the candidates.
notes: P2/P3 choice: #14 (Bellotto, Dresden from the right bank below the Augustus Bridge, 1748, 6175 px) is the strongest Dresden picture overall but is dated 1748, so it competes with Merian for P2; Merian was kept so 17th-century maps show the pre-baroque city, and #17 (about 1750) covers the 18th century. Swap #14 in for #9 if a stronger image matters more than the spread. #17’s date is the Commons field (about 1750–55); any Bellotto Dresden view falls within 1747–66. #22 is a Photoglob (P.Z.) print; #27 (Terrassenufer from the Carola Bridge) is an equally good alternative. #30: Poeschmann died 1954; Commons marks it public domain.
